name: strata
description: Strata site reliability validation console for incident telemetry, replay, and remediation simulation.

scripts.test: mocha tests/**/*.test.js && npm run check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/lib/incidents.js && node --check src/lib/sampleData.js && node --check public/app.js && python3 -m py_compile scripts/traffic_generator.py
